title: OpenAI's agent pipeline finds 948 Linux privilege-escalation flaws for $1.2 million
summary: OpenAI says an autonomous discovery, exploitation and patching pipeline audited about seven percent of the Linux kernel, 5,034 targets and roughly 2.8 million lines, and validated 948 distinct local privilege-escalation flaws with candidate patches. The mid-October run reproduced 1,724 of 2,308 candidate findings and cost $1,213,430 in API credits, about $1,279 per flaw. Reports have gone to maintainers; how many patches land upstream is a separate and still unpublished count.
